assertion: An event exists, described as "Lalique museum burglary".
judge_quote: Jewelry worth millions of dollars stolen from French museum in daring early-morning raid
evidence_cited: Burglars stole millions of dollars worth of jewelry from the museum of French luxury glassmaker Lalique in a daring early-morning raid on Sunday, just months after a stunning gem heist at the Louvre in Paris.

A gang of masked thieves broke in to the museum in Wingen-sur-Moder in northeastern France around 5:30 am, forcing a door before heading for the jewelry room and smashing open six display cases, a source close to the investigation told AFP.
The museum said on its website that it will be closed for several day because of the burglary.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Louvre museum heist".
judge_quote: just months after a stunning gem heist at the Louvre in Paris
evidence_cited: Thieves made off with $102 million worth of jewelry, including some of the old French crown jewels, from the Louvre in a raid lasting less than eight minutes.
The suspected thieves have been arrested and charged, but none of the jewels have been recovered except for a crown that was dropped as the group escaped.

evidence_cited: In September, thieves snatched three porcelain works worth millions of dollars and classed as national treasures in a heist at the Adrien Dubouche National Museum in Limoges in central France.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Cognacq-Jay museum heist".
judge_quote: four men with axes and baseball bats smashed the display cases... at the Cognacq-Jay museum
evidence_cited: In November 2024, four men with axes and baseball bats smashed the display cases in broad daylight at the Cognacq-Jay museum in Paris, making off with several 18th-century works.
That heist resulted in an insurance payment of over $4 million to the Royal Collection Trust, BBC News reported.
